features.title: Dark mode toggle
features.description: Add a dark/light mode toggle button in the header. Store preference in localStorage. Add CSS variables for all colors so switching themes only changes the root variables.

features.title: Habit categories / colors
features.description: Allow users to assign a color to each habit (pick from 8 preset swatches). Display the color as a left border on each habit card. Pass color through POST /api/habits and PATCH /api/habits/:id.

features.title: Task due-date countdown
features.description: Show a human-readable countdown next to tasks that have a due_date (e.g. 'due in 2 days', 'overdue 1 day'). Highlight overdue tasks in red. Compute this in the frontend from the due_date field already stored in the DB.

features.title: Habit frequency labels
features.description: Show a small badge next to each habit name indicating its frequency: 'daily', 'weekdays', or 'weekly'. Style as a subtle pill/chip using existing CSS variables.

features.title: Task notes expansion
features.description: Allow tasks to have multi-line notes. Add a 'expand' chevron to task cards that reveals the notes field inline. Notes are already stored in the DB; this is purely a frontend reveal/collapse using CSS height transitions.

features.title: Streak milestone toasts
features.description: When marking a habit complete causes the streak to hit 7, 14, 30, 60, or 100 days, show a toast notification (e.g. '🔥 30-day streak!'). Detect the milestone in the POST /api/habits/:id/complete response by comparing new vs old streak. Render toast in the frontend using a short-lived absolutely-positioned div.

features.title: Archive completed tasks
features.description: Add an 'Archive' tab (or section) under the Tasks tab showing tasks with status='done'. Add a 'Clear done' button that sets all done tasks to status='archived'. Archived tasks are hidden from the main list but accessible in the archive view.

completed.title: Dashboard — habits, tasks, streaks summary
completed.description: Built /api/dashboard/summary endpoint, real dashboard tab with stat cards, habit list, best streak, due today, and due soon panels.
